consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, which asks 'has the player accounted for item_count of type->item_id?' to gate the fetch objective's completion
scope: items reachable via the character's crafting_inventory() — carried plus nearby reachable items — not on-person only
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM): its body evaluates a yes/no by calling u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id, item_count) (with a has_charges fallback), so the authority is the engine-computed predicate result over the crafting-inventory reach
divergence: The required parts sit on an adjacent reachable tile (in crafting range) with none carried: the real engine predicate returns complete and the indicator lights, but an on-person-scoped possession check or a raw map::i_at item-stack tally (Excerpt 2, class S) would report not-met — exposing the wrong reach/authority
